dict.string: MacFixApp needs permission to read your Desktop so it can help tidy it up. Nothing is moved or deleted without your confirmation.
MacFixApp needs permission to look inside your Documents folder to help organize files. Nothing is moved or deleted without your confirmation.
MacFixApp needs permission to look inside your Downloads folder to help organize files. Nothing is moved or deleted without your confirmation.
MacFixApp needs permission to look inside your Pictures folder to help find duplicate photos. Nothing is moved or deleted without your confirmation.
